ko.title: 후티 반군의 미사일 및 드론 공습으로 사우디 석유 및 항공 시설 타격, 수십 명 부상

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## 조직적인 공격의 물결

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: 9월 8일, 예멘의 후티 반군이 사우디아라비아 전역의 5개 목표물을 겨냥해 조직적인 포격을 가하면서 사우디아라비아는 최근 기억에 남을 만큼 광범위한 미사일 및 드론 공격을 받았습니다.

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: 당국에 따르면 이번 공습으로 아브하 국제공항, 아람코 연료 분배 터미널, 군사 공군 기지, 그리고 두 곳의 정유 시설이 피해를 입었으며, 여러 현장에서 화재가 발생하고 70명 이상의 부상자가 발생했습니다.

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: 사우디 민방위대는 밤새 피해 시설의 화재를 진압하기 위해 노력했습니다.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 부상 정도가 경상에서 중상까지 다양하며, 부상자 대부분은 공항 직원, 정유소 근로자, 인근 주민이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: 최신 공식 발표에 따르면 사망자는 확인되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## 사건의 전말

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: 사우디 국영 매체와 연합군 대변인에 따르면, 이번 공격은 사우디의 방공망을 무력화하기 위해 설계된 파상 공세로 탄도 미사일과 폭발물을 실은 드론을 결합한 형태였습니다.

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: 요격 미사일이 날아오는 발사체 일부를 격추한 것으로 알려졌으나, 여러 발의 미사일과 드론이 사우디 영공을 뚫고 목표물을 타격했습니다.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: 아람코 연료 터미널에서 발생한 화재는 현지 분배 운영을 잠시 중단시켰으나, 이후 진압되었습니다.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: 공격을 받은 두 곳의 정유소는 사우디의 광범위한 에너지 인프라의 일부이지만, 관계자들은 생산에 큰 차질은 없었다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: 예멘 국경 근처에서 민간 및 군용 항공편을 모두 처리하는 아브하 공항은 과거에도 국경을 넘는 공격의 표적이 된 적이 있으며, 이번 공습 이후 잠시 운영이 중단되었습니다.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## 후티 반군의 주장과 지역적 맥락

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: 예멘 북부의 상당 부분을 장악하고 있는 후티 반군의 군사 대변인은 이번 작전이 사우디 주도 연합군의 예멘 내전 개입에 대한 보복이라고 주장하며 책임을 인정했습니다.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: 공식 명칭이 '안사르 알라'인 이 단체는 수년간 장거리 미사일과 드론을 사용하여 사우디 영토를 공격해 왔으며, 이러한 공격을 예멘을 황폐화시킨 공습과 봉쇄에 대한 대응이라고 주장해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: 후티 반군은 이란으로부터 정치적, 재정적, 그리고 군사적 지원을 받는 것으로 알려져 있지만, 테헤란은 특정 공격에 대한 직접적인 개입은 일관되게 부인해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: 사우디아라비아와 그 동맹국들은 오랫동안 이란이 사우디 깊숙한 곳의 목표물을 타격하는 데 필요한 기술을 이 단체에 제공했다고 비난해 왔으나, 이란 당국은 이를 근거 없는 주장이라며 일축했습니다.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## 사우디의 대응

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: 사우디 당국은 이번 공격을 강력히 규탄했으며, 정부 성명을 통해 책임자들에게 "단호한 보복"을 가할 것이라고 다짐했습니다.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: 사우디 외무부는 이번 공습이 국제법 위반이자 지역 에너지 안보에 대한 위협이라고 규정하며, 국제 사회가 후티 반군과 그 배후 세력에게 책임을 물을 것을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 사우디가 세계 최대 원유 수출국 중 하나라는 점을 고려할 때, 사우디 석유 인프라에 대한 공격은 즉각적인 피해 이상의 의미를 갖는다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: 2019년 아브카이크와 쿠라이스 시설에 대한 대규모 공격을 포함하여, 과거 사우디 에너지 시설을 겨냥한 사건들은 세계 원유 공급을 일시적으로 중단시키고 국제 시장을 뒤흔든 바 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: 이번 공격은 유엔이 중재한 수년간의 협상에도 불구하고 휴전이 주기적으로 깨지는 등 취약한 상태가 지속되고 있는 예멘 내전 상황 속에서 발생했습니다.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: 외교관들은 추가적인 긴장 고조가 리야드와 후티 반군 간의 더 광범위한 휴전을 위한 최근의 노력을 무산시킬 위험이 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: 사우디 당국은 보복의 형태에 대해 구체적으로 밝히지 않았으며, 지역 관측통들은 군사적 긴장이 다시 고조될 조짐이 있는지 예의주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: 한편, 피해 시설에 대한 피해 평가와 복구 작업이 계속되고 있으며, 국제 에너지 시장은 원유 공급에 미칠 영향이 있는지 상황을 모니터링하고 있습니다.

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *이 보고서는 사우디 당국과 후티 반군 대표들의 최신 공식 성명을 바탕으로 작성되었습니다.

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: 조사가 계속됨에 따라 세부 내용은 업데이트될 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 胡塞武装导弹和无人机密集袭击沙特石油与航空设施，造成数十人受伤

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## 一波有协调的袭击

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: 9月8日，沙特阿拉伯遭到近年来最广泛的导弹和无人机袭击之一，也门胡塞武装对该国境内的五个不同目标发动了协同攻击。

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: 当局表示，袭击导致艾卜哈国际机场、阿美公司燃料分销终端、一个军事空军基地以及两座炼油厂受损，多处地点燃起大火，并有70多人受伤。

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: 沙特民防团队彻夜工作，控制受影响设施的火势。

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: 官员称，伤势从轻微到严重不等，多数伤者为机场员工、炼油厂工人和附近居民。

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: 截至最新的官方通报，尚未有死亡确认。

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## 发生了什么

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: 根据沙特官方媒体和联盟发言人的说法，这次袭击结合了弹道导弹和装载炸药的无人机，分波次发射，旨在压垮该国的防空系统。

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: 据报道，拦截器击落了一部分来袭弹丸，但几枚导弹和无人机穿透了沙特领空并击中了预定目标。

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: 阿美燃料终端发生火灾，在工作人员控制住火势之前，短暂中断了当地的分销作业。

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: 被攻击的两座炼油厂是该国更广泛能源基础设施的一部分，但官员表示产量并未受到重大影响。

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: 艾卜哈机场靠近也门边境，服务于民用和军事飞行，过去曾成为跨境袭击的目标，并在袭击后短暂暂停运营。

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## 胡塞武装的主张与地区背景

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: 控制也门北部大部分地区的胡塞武装的一名军事发言人声称对此次行动负责，称这是对沙特领导的联军在也门内战中所扮演角色的报复。

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: 该组织正式名称为“安萨尔真主”，多年来一直使用远程导弹和无人机袭击沙特领土，将这些袭击描述为对空袭和封锁的回应，他们称这些空袭和封锁摧毁了也门。

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: 胡塞武装获得来自伊朗的政治、财政以及据称的军事支持，尽管德黑兰一再否认直接参与具体袭击。

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: 沙特阿拉伯及其盟友长期指责伊朗向该组织提供深入打击该国境内目标所需的科技，伊朗官员则驳斥这一指控毫无根据。

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## 沙特的反应

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: 沙特官员以严厉措辞谴责了这次袭击，政府声明誓言对肇事者进行“坚决报复”。

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: 该国外交部呼吁国际社会追究胡塞武装及其支持者的责任，称这些袭击是对国际法的侵犯和对地区能源安全的威胁。

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，鉴于沙特作为世界最大原油出口国之一的角色，对沙特石油基础设施的袭击具有超越直接损失的意义。

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: 此前针对沙特能源设施的事件，包括2019年对胡赖斯和布盖格的大规模袭击，曾短暂中断全球石油供应并震撼了国际市场。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: 这次袭击发生之际，也门正处于脆弱而漫长的冲突之中，尽管经过联合国斡旋多年的谈判，脆弱的休战状态仍不时破裂。

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: 外交官们警告称，进一步升级有风险破坏利雅得与胡塞武装之间达成更广泛停火的近期努力。

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: 沙特当局尚未详细说明报复可能采取的形式，地区观察员正在密切关注军事再次升级的迹象。

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: 与此同时，受影响地点的损失评估和修复工作仍在继续，而国际能源市场正在监测局势对石油供应的任何影响。

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *本报告反映了截至沙特当局和胡塞代表最新官方声明所获得的可用信息。

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: 随着调查的继续，细节可能会更新。*

hi.title: हूथी मिसाइल और ड्रोन बैराज ने सऊदी तेल और विमानन स्थलों को बनाया निशाना, दर्जनों घायल

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## हमलों की एक समन्वित लहर

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: 8 सितंबर को सऊदी अरब हाल के दिनों के सबसे बड़े मिसाइल और ड्रोन हमलों में से एक की चपेट में आ गया, जब यमन के हूथी आंदोलन ने किंगडम भर में पांच अलग-अलग लक्ष्यों पर एक समन्वित हमला किया।

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों का कहना है कि हमलों में आभा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे, अरामको ईंधन वितरण टर्मिनल, एक सैन्य एयर बेस और दो तेल रिफाइनरियों को नुकसान पहुंचा, जिससे कई स्थानों पर आग लग गई और 70 से अधिक लोग घायल हो गए।

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: सऊदी नागरिक सुरक्षा टीमों ने प्रभावित सुविधाओं पर आग पर काबू पाने के लिए पूरी रात काम किया।

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने बताया कि चोटें मामूली से लेकर गंभीर थीं, जिनमें से अधिकांश घायल हवाई अड्डा कर्मचारियों, रिफाइनरी श्रमिकों और पास के निवासियों में से थे।

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: नवीनतम आधिकारिक अपडेट के अनुसार किसी भी मौत की पुष्टि नहीं हुई है।

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## क्या हुआ

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: सऊदी राज्य मीडिया और गठबंधन के प्रवक्ताओं के अनुसार, इस हमले में बैलिस्टिक मिसाइलों और विस्फोटक से लदे ड्रोनों को शामिल किया गया था, जिन्हें किंगडम की वायु रक्षा प्रणालियों को पस्त करने के लिए लहरों में दागा गया था।

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: खबरों के अनुसार इंटरसेप्टर ने आने वाले प्रोजेक्टाइल के एक हिस्से को मार गिराया, लेकिन कई मिसाइलें और ड्रोन सऊदी हवाई क्षेत्र में घुस आए और अपने लक्षित ठिकानों पर हमला किया।

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: अरामको ईंधन टर्मिनल में आग लग गई जिससे क्रू द्वारा इसे नियंत्रण में लाने से पहले स्थानीय वितरण संचालन कुछ समय के लिए बाधित हो गया।

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: निशाने पर आई दो रिफाइनरियां किंगडम के व्यापक ऊर्जा बुनियादी ढांचे का हिस्सा हैं, हालांकि अधिकारियों ने कहा कि उत्पादन में कोई महत्वपूर्ण बाधा नहीं आई है।

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: यमन सीमा के पास नागरिक और सैन्य दोनों उड़ानों को सेवा देने वाले आभा हवाई अड्डे को पिछले सीमा पार हमलों में निशाना बनाया गया है और हमले के बाद इसके संचालन को थोड़े समय के लिए निलंबित कर दिया गया था।

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## हूथी के दावे और क्षेत्रीय संदर्भ

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: उत्तरी यमन के बड़े हिस्से को नियंत्रित करने वाले हूथी आंदोलन के एक सैन्य प्रवक्ता ने इस ऑपरेशन की जिम्मेदारी लेते हुए इसे यमन के गृहयुद्ध में चल रही सऊदी के नेतृत्व वाले गठबंधन की भूमिका का बदला बताया।

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: यह समूह, जिसे औपचारिक रूप से अंसार अल्लाह के रूप में जाना जाता है, ने वर्षों से सऊदी क्षेत्र पर हमला करने के लिए लंबी दूरी की मिसाइलों और ड्रोनों का उपयोग किया है, और इन हमलों को हवाई हमलों और नाकाबंदी के जवाब के रूप में पेश किया है जिससे यमन तबाह हो गया है।

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: हूथी को ईरान से राजनीतिक, वित्तीय और कथित तौर पर सैन्य समर्थन प्राप्त है, हालांकि तेहरान ने लगातार विशिष्ट हमलों में प्रत्यक्ष संलिप्तता से इनकार किया है।

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: सऊदी अरब और उसके सहयोगियों ने लंबे समय से ईरान पर किंगडम के अंदर गहराई तक लक्ष्यों को हिट करने के लिए आवश्यक तकनीक से समूह को लैस करने का आरोप लगाया है, एक ऐसा आरोप जिसे ईरानी अधिकारियों ने निराधार बताते हुए खारिज कर दिया है।

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## सऊदी प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: सऊदी अधिकारियों ने कड़े शब्दों में इस हमले की निंदा की, और एक सरकारी बयान में जिम्मेदार लोगों के खिलाफ "कड़ी जवाबी कार्रवाई" की कसम खाई।

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: किंगडम के विदेश मंत्रालय ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय समुदाय से हूथियों और उनके समर्थकों को जवाबदेह ठहराने का आह्वान किया, और इन हमलों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून का उल्लंघन और क्षेत्रीय ऊर्जा सुरक्षा के लिए खतरा बताया।

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि दुनिया के सबसे बड़े कच्चे तेल निर्यातक के रूप में किंगडम की भूमिका को देखते हुए सऊदी तेल बुनियादी ढांचा पर हमले तात्कालिक नुकसान से परे महत्व रखते हैं।

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: सऊदी ऊर्जा सुविधाओं को लक्षित करने वाली पिछली घटनाएं, जिसमें अबक़ैक़ और खुरैश पर 2019 का एक बड़ा हमला शामिल है, ने थोड़े समय के लिए वैश्विक तेल आपूर्ति को बाधित किया और अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजारों को हिला दिया था।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या आता है

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: यह हमला यमन में एक नाजुक और लंबे समय से चल रहे संघर्ष के बीच आया है, जहां संयुक्त राष्ट्र के नेतृत्व वाली वार्ताओं के बावजूद एक नाजुक संघर्ष विराम समय-समय पर टूट गया है।

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: राजनयिकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि आगे की वृद्धि से रियाद और हूथी आंदोलन के बीच एक व्यापक संघर्ष विराम की हालिया कोशिशों के पटरी से उतरने का जोखिम है।

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: सऊदी अधिकारियों ने यह विस्तार से नहीं बताया है कि जवाबी कार्रवाई किस रूप में हो सकती है, और क्षेत्रीय पर्यवेक्षक नए सिरे से सैन्य वृद्धि के संकेतों पर करीब से नजर रख रहे हैं।

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: इस बीच, प्रभावित स्थलों पर क्षति का आकलन और मरम्मत के प्रयास जारी हैं, जबकि अंतरराष्ट्रीय ऊर्जा बाजार तेल आपूर्ति पर किसी भी प्रभाव के लिए स्थिति की निगरानी कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *यह रिपोर्ट सऊदी अधिकारियों और हूथी प्रतिनिधियों के नवीनतम आधिकारिक बstatements के अनुसार उपलब्ध जानकारी को दर्शाती है।

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: जांच जारी रहने पर विवरण अपडेट किया जा सकता है.*

es.title: Andanada de misiles y drones hutíes ataca sitios petroleros y de aviación en Arabia Saudita, dejando decenas de heridos

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## Una ola coordinada de ataques

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: Arabia Saudita sufrió uno de los ataques con misiles y drones más extensos de los últimos tiempos el 8 de septiembre, cuando el movimiento hutí de Yemen lanzó una andanada coordinada contra cinco objetivos distintos en todo el reino.

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: Las autoridades afirman que los ataques dañaron el Aeropuerto Internacional de Abha, una terminal de distribución de combustible de Aramco, una base aérea militar y dos refinerías de petróleo, dejando incendios en múltiples sitios y más de 70 personas heridas.

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: Los equipos de defensa civil saudíes trabajaron durante la noche para contener los incendios en las instalaciones afectadas.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios dijeron que las lesiones iban de leves a graves, notificándose la mayoría de los heridos entre el personal del aeropuerto, los trabajadores de la refinería y los residentes cercanos.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: No se habían confirmado víctimas mortales hasta la última actualización oficial.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Qué sucedió

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: Según los medios estatales saudíes y los portavoces de la coalición, el ataque combinó misiles balísticos y drones cargados de explosivos disparados en olas diseñadas para abrumar los sistemas de defensa aérea del reino.

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: Según los informes, los interceptores derribaron una parte de los proyectiles entrantes, pero varios misiles y drones penetraron el espacio aéreo saudí e impactaron en sus objetivos previstos.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: La terminal de combustible de Aramco sufrió un incendio que interrumpió brevemente las operaciones de distribución local antes de que los equipos lo controlaran.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: Las dos refinerías atacadas forman parte de la infraestructura energética más amplia del reino, aunque los funcionarios dijeron que la producción no se interrumpió de manera significativa.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: El aeropuerto de Abha, que atiende vuelos tanto civiles como militares cerca de la frontera con Yemen, ha sido objeto de ataques transfronterizos en el pasado y suspendió brevemente las operaciones tras el impacto.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## Reclamaciones hutíes y contexto regional

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: Un portavoz militar del movimiento hutí, que controla grandes partes del norte de Yemen, se atribuyó la responsabilidad de la operación, describiéndola como una represalia por el papel continuo de la coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en la guerra civil de Yemen.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: El grupo, conocido formalmente como Ansar Allah, ha utilizado durante años misiles de largo alcance y drones para atacar territorio saudí, enmarcando los ataques como una respuesta a los ataques aéreos y al bloqueo que, según afirma, han devastado Yemen.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: Los hutíes reciben apoyo político, financiero y, según se informa, militar de Irán, aunque Teherán ha negado sistemáticamente su participación directa en ataques específicos.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: Arabia Saudita y sus aliados acusan desde hace tiempo a Irán de armar al grupo con la tecnología necesaria para atacar objetivos en lo más profundo del reino, una acusación que los funcionarios iraníes rechazan por carecer de fundamento.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## Respuesta saudí

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios saudíes condenaron el ataque en términos contundentes, y una declaración del gobierno prometió "firmes represalias" contra los responsables.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: El ministerio de asuntos exteriores del reino pidió a la comunidad internacional que exija responsabilidades a los hutíes y a sus partidarios, describiendo los ataques como una violación del derecho internacional y una amenaza para la seguridad energética regional.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que los ataques contra la infraestructura petrolera saudí tienen un significado que va más allá de los daños inmediatos, dado el papel del reino como uno de los mayores exportadores de petróleo crudo del mundo.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: Incidentes anteriores dirigidos a instalaciones energéticas saudíes, incluido un ataque importante en 2019 contra Abqaiq y Khurais, interrumpieron brevemente el suministro mundial de petróleo y alteraron los mercados internacionales.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué viene después

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: El ataque se produce en medio de un conflicto frágil y prolongado en Yemen, donde una tregua Inestable se ha roto periódicamente a pesar de años de negociaciones mediadas por las Naciones Unidas.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: Los diplomáticos han advertido de que una mayor escalada corre el riesgo de descarrilar los esfuerzos recientes hacia un alto el fuego más amplio entre Riad y el movimiento hutí.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: Las autoridades saudíes no han detallado qué forma podrían tomar las represalias, y los observadores regionales están atentos a cualquier señal de una nueva escalada militar.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, las evaluaciones de daños y los esfuerzos de reparación continúan en los sitios afectados, mientras que los mercados internacionales de energía vigilan la situación ante cualquier impacto en el suministro de petróleo.

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *Este informe refleja la información disponible a partir de las últimas declaraciones oficiales de las autoridades saudíes y representantes hutíes.

segments.tr: Los detalles pueden actualizarse a medida que continúen las investigaciones.*

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: وقال المسؤولون إن الإصابات تراوحت بين طفيفة وخطيرة، حيث تم الإبلاغ عن معظم الجرحى بين موظفي المطار وعمال المصافي والسكان القريبين.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## ماذا حدث

segments.tr: وفقاً لوسائل الإعلام الرسمية السعودية والمتحدثين باسم التحالف، جمع الهجوم بين صواريخ باليستية وطائرات بدون طيار محملة بالمتفجرات أُطلقت في موجات مصممة لإغراق أنظمة الدفاع الجوي للمملكة.

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: وأفادت التقارير أن منظومات الاعتراض أسقطت جزءاً من المقذوفات القادمة، لكن العديد من الصواريخ والطائرات بدون طيار اخترقت المجال الجوي السعودي وأصابت أهدافها المقصودة.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: وتعرضت محطة وقود أرامكو لحريق أدى إلى تعطيل عمليات التوزيع المحلية لفترة وجيزة قبل أن تتمكن الفرق من السيطرة عليه.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: والمصفاتان المستهدفتان هما جزء من البنية التحتية للطاقة الأوسع في المملكة، على الرغم من أن المسؤولين قالوا إن الإنتاج لم يتأثر بشكل كبير.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: ومطار أبها، الذي يخدم الرحلات المدنية والعسكرية بالقرب من الحدود اليمنية، تم استهدافه في هجمات سابقة عبر الحدود وعلق لفترة وجيزة العمليات في أعقاب الضربة.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## مزاعم الحوثيين والسياق الإقليمي

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: أعلن متحدث عسكري باسم حركة الحوثي، التي تسيطر على أجزاء كبيرة من شمال اليمن، المسؤولية عن العملية، واصفاً إياها بأنها رد على الدور المستمر للتحالف الذي تقوده السعودية في الحرب الأهلية في اليمن.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: استخدمت المجموعة، المعروفة رسمياً باسم أنصار الله، لسنوات صواريخ بعيدة المدى وطائرات بدون طيار لضرب الأراضي السعودية، مؤطرة الهجمات كاستجابة للغارات الجوية والحصار الذي تقول إنه دمر اليمن.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: يتلقى الحوثيون دعماً سياسياً ومالياً وحسب التقارير عسكرياً من إيران، على الرغم من أن طهران نفت باستمرار التورط المباشر في هجمات محددة.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: واتهمت السعودية وحلفاؤها إيران منذ فترة طويلة بتسليح الجماعة بالتكنولوجيا اللازمة لضرب أهداف في عمق المملكة، وهو اتهام يرفضه المسؤولون الإيرانيون باعتباره لا أساس له من الصحة.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## الرد السعودي

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: أدان المسؤولون السعوديون الهجوم بشدة، حيث تعهد بيان حكومي بـ"رد حازم" ضد المسؤولين عنه.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: ودعت وزارة الخارجية في المملكة المجتمع الدولي إلى محاسبة الحوثيين وداعميهم، واصفة الضربات بأنها انتهاك للقانون الدولي وتهديد لأمن الطاقة الإقليمي.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: ويشير المحللون إلى أن الهجمات على البنية التحتية للنفط السعودي تحمل أهمية تتجاوز الضرر المباشر، بالنظر إلى دور المملكة كواحدة من أكبر مصدري النفط الخام في العالم.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: وقد أدت الحوادث السابقة التي استهدفت منشآت الطاقة السعودية، بما في ذلك هجوم كبير عام 2019 على بقيق وخريص، إلى تعطيل إمدادات النفط العالمية لفترة وجيزة وتحريك الأسواق الدولية.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ما يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: يأتي الهجوم وسط صراع هش ومستمر منذ فترة طويلة في اليمن، حيث انهارت هدنة هشّة دورياً على الرغم من سنوات من المفاوضات بوساطة الأمم المتحدة.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: وحذر الدبلوماسيون من أن المزيد من التصعيد يهدد بعرقلة الجهود الأخيرة نحو وقف إطلاق نار أوسع بين الرياض وحركة الحوثي.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: ولم تفصل السلطات السعودية الشكل الذي قد يتخذه الرد، ويراقب المراقبون الإقليميون عن كثب علامات التصعيد العسكري المتجدد.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، تستمر تقييمات الأضرار وجهود الإصلاح في المواقع المتضررة، بينما تراقب أسواق الطاقة الدولية الوضع بحثاً عن أي تأثير على إمدادات النفط.

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *يعكس هذا التقرير المعلومات المتاحة اعتباراً من أحدث البيانات الرسمية الصادرة عن السلطات السعودية وممثلي الحوثيين.

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: قد يتم تحديث التفاصيل مع استمرار التحقيقات.*

fr.title: Un barrage de missiles et de drones houthis frappe des sites pétroliers et aéronautiques saoudiens, faisant des dizaines de blessés

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## Une vague d'attaques coordonnées

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: L'Arabie saoudite a été frappée par l'un des assauts de missiles et de drones les plus vastes de mémoire récente le 8 septembre, lorsque le mouvement houthi du Yémen a lancé un barrage coordonné contre cinq cibles distinctes à travers le royaume.

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: Les autorités affirment que les frappes ont endommagé l'aéroport international d'Abha, un terminal de distribution de carburant d'Aramco, une base aérienne militaire et deux raffineries de pétrole, laissant des incendies actifs sur plusieurs sites et faisant plus de 70 blessés.

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: Les équipes de la défense civile saoudienne ont travaillé toute la nuit pour maîtriser les incendies dans les installations touchées.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: Les responsables ont déclaré que les blessures allaient de légères à graves, la plupart des blessés étant signalés parmi le personnel de l'aéroport, les travailleurs des raffineries et les résidents des environs.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: Aucun décès n'avait été confirmé lors de la dernière mise à jour officielle.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Ce qui s'est passé

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: Selon les médias d'État saoudiens et les porte-paroles de la coalition, l'attaque a combiné des missiles balistiques et des drones chargés d'explosifs lancés par vagues successives pour saturer les systèmes de défense aérienne du royaume.

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: Les intercepteurs auraient abattu une partie des projectiles entrants, mais plusieurs missiles et drones ont pénétré l'espace aérien saoudien et ont frappé leurs cibles prévues.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: Le terminal de carburant d'Aramco a subi un incendie qui a brièvement perturbé les opérations de distribution locale avant que les équipes ne le maîtrisent.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: Les deux raffineries visées font partie de l'infrastructure énergétique plus large du royaume, bien que les responsables aient déclaré que la production n'avait pas été perturbée de manière significative.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: L'aéroport d'Abha, qui dessert des vols civils et militaires près de la frontière yéménite, a déjà été la cible d'attaques transfrontalières par le passé et a brièvement suspendu ses opérations à la suite de la frappe.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## Revendications des Houthis et contexte régional

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: Un porte-parole militaire du mouvement houthi, qui contrôle de vastes parties du nord du Yémen, a revendiqué la responsabilité de l'opération, la décrivant comme une riposte au rôle continu de la coalition dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite dans la guerre civile au Yémen.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: Le groupe, officiellement connu sous le nom d'Ansar Allah, utilise depuis des années des missiles à longue portée et des drones pour frapper le territoire saoudien, présentant ces attaques comme une réponse aux frappes aériennes et au blocus qui, selon lui, ont dévasté le Yémen.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: Les Houthis reçoivent un soutien politique, financier et, selon certaines sources, militaire de l'Iran, bien que Téhéran ait constamment nié toute implication directe dans des attaques spécifiques.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: L'Arabie saoudite et ses alliés accusent depuis longtemps l'Iran d'armer le groupe avec la technologie nécessaire pour frapper des cibles au cœur du royaume, une accusation que les responsables iraniens rejettent comme non fondée.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## Réaction saoudienne

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: Les responsables saoudiens ont condamné l'attaque en termes vigoureux, un communiqué du gouvernement promettant une « riposte ferme » contre les responsables.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: Le ministère des Affaires étrangères du royaume a appelé la communauté internationale à tenir les Houthis et leurs soutiens pour responsables, qualifiant les frappes de violation du droit international et de menace pour la sécurité énergétique régionale.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: Les analystes soulignent que les attaques contre les infrastructures pétrolières saoudiennes ont une importance qui dépasse les dommages immédiats, compte tenu du rôle du royaume en tant qu'un des plus grands exportateurs de pétrole brut au monde.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: Des incidents antérieurs ciblant des installations énergétiques saoudiennes, notamment une frappe majeure en 2019 contre Abqaiq et Khurais, avaient brièvement perturbé l'approvisionnement mondial en pétrole et fait réagir les marchés internationaux.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite ?

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: L'attaque survient au milieu d'un conflit fragile et de longue date au Yémen, où une trêve précaire s'est périodiquement effondrée malgré des années de négociations sous l'égide des Nations Unies.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: Les diplomates ont averti qu'une nouvelle escalade risquait de faire dérailler les efforts récents en vue d'un cessez-le-feu plus large entre Riyad et le mouvement houthi.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: Les autorités saoudiennes n'ont pas précisé quelle forme pourrait prendre la riposte, et les observateurs régionaux surveillent de près tout signe d'une nouvelle escalade militaire.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: En attendant, les évaluations des dégâts et les efforts de réparation se poursuivent sur les sites touchés, tandis que les marchés énergétiques internationaux surveillent la situation pour tout impact sur l'approvisionnement en pétrole.

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *Ce rapport reflète les informations disponibles lors des dernières déclarations officielles des autorités saoudiennes et des représentants des Houthis.

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: Les détails peuvent être mis à jour au fur et à mesure que les enquêtes se poursuivent.*

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## Resposta Saudita

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: Autoridades sauditas condenaram o ataque em termos fortes, com uma declaração do governo prometendo "retaliação firme" contra os responsáveis.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.

segments.tr: As autoridades sauditas não detalharam que forma a retaliação pode assumir, e os observadores regionais estão observando de perto em busca de sinais de uma nova escalada militar.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.

in.title: Rentetan Rudal dan Drone Houthi Menghantam Situs Minyak dan Penerbangan Arab Saudi, Melukai Puluhan Orang

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## Gelombang Serangan Terkoordinasi

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: Arab Saudi dihantam oleh salah satu serangan rudal dan drone paling ekstensif dalam sejarah terkini pada 8 September, ketika gerakan Houthi Yaman melancarkan rentetan serangan terkoordinasi terhadap lima sasaran terpisah di seluruh kerajaan.

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: Pihak berwenang mengatakan serangan itu merusak Bandara Internasional Abha, terminal distribusi bahan bakar Aramco, pangkalan udara militer, dan dua kilang minyak, menyebabkan kebakaran di beberapa lokasi dan lebih dari 70 orang terluka.

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: Tim pertahanan sipil Arab Saudi bekerja sepanjang malam untuk memadamkan kobaran api di fasilitas yang terdampak.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: Para pejabat mengatakan luka-luka berkisar dari ringan hingga serius, dengan sebagian besar korban terluka dilaporkan di antara staf bandara, pekerja kilang, dan warga sekitar.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: Belum ada korban jiwa yang dikonfirmasi hingga pembaruan resmi terbaru.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: Menurut media pemerintah Arab Saudi dan juru bicara koalisi, serangan tersebut menggabungkan rudal balistik dan drone bermuatan bahan peledak yang ditembakkan dalam gelombang yang dirancang untuk melumpuhkan sistem pertahanan udara kerajaan.

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: Pencegat dilaporkan menjatuhkan sebagian dari proyektil yang datang, namun beberapa rudal dan drone menembus ruang udara Arab Saudi dan menghantam target yang dituju.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: Terminal bahan bakar Aramco mengalami kebakaran yang sempat mengganggu operasi distribusi lokal sebelum petugas berhasil mengendalikannya.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: Dua kilang yang menjadi sasaran adalah bagian dari infrastruktur energi kerajaan yang lebih luas, meskipun para pejabat mengatakan produksi tidak terganggu secara signifikan.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: Bandara Abha, yang melayani penerbangan sipil dan militer di dekat perbatasan Yaman, telah menjadi sasaran dalam serangan lintas batas sebelumnya dan sempat menghentikan operasinya setelah serangan tersebut.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## Klaim Houthi dan Konteks Regional

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: Juru bicara militer untuk gerakan Houthi, yang mengendalikan sebagian besar wilayah utara Yaman, mengklaim bertanggung jawab atas operasi tersebut, menggambarkannya sebagai pembalasan atas peran koalisi pimpinan Arab Saudi yang sedang berlangsung dalam perang saudara di Yaman.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: Kelompok tersebut, yang secara resmi dikenal sebagai Ansar Allah, telah bertahun-tahun menggunakan rudal jarak jauh dan drone untuk menghantam wilayah Arab Saudi, membingkai serangan tersebut sebagai tanggapan terhadap serangan udara dan blokade yang dikatakannya telah menghancurkan Yaman.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: Kelompok Houthi menerima dukungan politik, keuangan, dan dilaporkan dukungan militer dari Iran, meskipun Teheran secara konsisten membantah keterlibatan langsung dalam serangan tertentu.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: Arab Saudi dan sekutunya telah lama menuduh Iran mempersejatai kelompok tersebut dengan teknologi yang dibutuhkan untuk menghantam target jauh di dalam wilayah kerajaan, sebuah tuduhan yang ditolak oleh para pejabat Iran karena tidak berdasar.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## Tanggapan Arab Saudi

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: Para pejabat Arab Saudi mengecam serangan itu dengan nada keras, dengan pernyataan pemerintah yang menjanjikan "balasan tegas" terhadap mereka yang bertanggung jawab.

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: Kementerian luar negeri kerajaan menyerukan kepada masyarakat internasional untuk meminta pertanggungjawaban Houthi dan pendukung mereka, menggambarkan serangan tersebut sebagai pelanggaran hukum internasional dan ancaman terhadap keamanan energi regional.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa serangan terhadap infrastruktur minyak Arab Saudi memiliki arti penting melampaui kerusakan langsung, mengingat peran kerajaan sebagai salah satu eksportir minyak mentah terbesar di dunia.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: Insiden sebelumnya yang menyasar fasilitas energi Arab Saudi, termasuk serangan besar tahun 2019 di Abqaiq dan Khurais, sempat mengganggu pasokan minyak global dan menggerakkan pasar internasional.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: Serangan itu terjadi di tengah konflik yang rapuh dan berkepanjangan di Yaman, di mana gencatan senjata yang rapuh secara berkala runtuh meskipun telah ada negosiasi yang ditengahi Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: Para diplomat telah memperingatkan bahwa eskalasi lebih lanjut berisiko menggagalkan upaya terbaru menuju gencatan senjata yang lebih luas antara Riyadh dan gerakan Houthi.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: Pihak berwenang Arab Saudi belum merinci bentuk pembalasan yang mungkin dilakukan, dan pengamat regional mengamati dengan cermat tanda-tanda pembaruan eskalasi militer.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, penilaian kerusakan dan upaya perbaikan terus berlanjut di lokasi-lokasi yang terdampak, sementara pasar energi internasional memantau situasi untuk melihat dampak apa pun pada pasokan minyak.

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *Laporan ini mencerminkan informasi yang tersedia hingga pernyataan resmi terbaru dari pihak berwenang Arab Saudi dan perwakilan Houthi.

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: Rincian dapat diperbarui seiring berlanjutnya penyelidikan.*

ja.title: フーシ派のミサイル・ドローン一斉攻撃がサウジの石油・航空施設を直撃、数テン名が負傷

segments.src: ## A Coordinated Wave of Attacks
segments.tr: ## 組織的な攻撃の波

segments.src: Saudi Arabia was hit by one of the most extensive missile and drone assaults in recent memory on September 8, when Yemen's Houthi movement launched a coordinated barrage against five separate targets across the kingdom.
segments.tr: 9月8日、イエメンのフーシ派がサウジアラビア全土の5つの別々の目標に対して連携した一斉攻撃を開始し、サウジアラビアは近年で最も大規模なミサイルおよびドローンによる攻撃に見舞われました。

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: 当局によると、この攻撃によりアブハ国際空港、アラムコ燃料配送ターミナル、軍用飛行場、および2基の製油所が損害を受け、複数の場所で火災が発生し、70人以上が負傷しました。

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.
segments.tr: サウジの民防チームは、被害を受けた施設での火災を鎮圧するために徹夜で作業を行いました。

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.
segments.tr: 当局者は、負傷者の症状は軽症から重症まで様々で、負傷者の大部分は空港職員、製油所作業員、および周辺住民であると発表しました。

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.
segments.tr: 最新の公式発表の時点で、死亡者は確認されていません。

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## 何が起きたのか

segments.src: According to Saudi state media and coalition spokespeople, the attack combined ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones fired in waves designed to overwhelm the kingdom's air defense systems.
segments.tr: サウジ国営メディアおよび連合軍報道官によると、今回の攻撃はサウジアラビアの防空システムを圧倒するように設計された波状攻撃で、弾道ミサイルと爆薬を搭載したドローンを組み合わせたものでした。

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: 迎撃ミサイルにより飛来した飛翔体の一部は墜落させられましたが、いくつかのミサイルやドローンがサウジ領空を突破し、狙った目標に着弾しました。

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.
segments.tr: アラムコの燃料ターミナルでは火災が発生し、作業員が鎮火するまで一時的に地域の配送業務が中断されました。

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.
segments.tr: 標的となった2基の製油所は同国の広範なエネルギーインフラの一部ですが、当局者は生産に大幅な影響は出なかったと述べています。

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: イエメン国境近くに位置し、民間機と軍用機の両方が利用するアブハ空港は、過去の国境を越えた攻撃でも標的とされており、今回の攻撃を受けて一時的に運用を停止しました。

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## フーシ派の主張と地域情勢

segments.src: A military spokesperson for the Houthi movement, which controls large parts of northern Yemen, claimed responsibility for the operation, describing it as retaliation for the ongoing Saudi-led coalition's role in Yemen's civil war.
segments.tr: イエメン北部の大部分を支配するフーシ派の軍事報道官は作戦への関与を認め、イエメン内戦で続くサウジ主導連合軍の役割に対する報復であると説明しました。

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: 正式名称アンサール・アッラーとして知られる同グループは、イエメンを荒廃させた空爆や封鎖への対応だとして、サウジ領土を攻撃するために長年にわたり長距離ミサイルやドローンを使用してきました。

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: フーシ派はイランから政治的、資金的、そして報道によれば軍事的な支援を受けていますが、テヘラン側は特定の攻撃への直接的な関与を終始否定しています。

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: サウジアラビアとその同盟国は、サウジ国内深部の目標を攻撃するのに必要な技術を同グループに供給しているとして長年イランを非難していますが、イラン当局者はこの主張を根拠がないとして退けています。

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## サウジアラビアの対応

segments.src: Saudi officials condemned the attack in strong terms, with a government statement vowing "firm retaliation" against those responsible.
segments.tr: サウジ当局者は攻撃を強い言葉で非難し、政府声明で責任者に対する「断固とした報復」を誓いました。

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: 同国の外務省は国際社会に対し、フーシ派とその支援者の責任を問うよう求め、今回の攻撃は国際法違反であり地域のエネルギー安全保障に対する脅威であると述べました。

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: アナリストらは、世界最大級の原油輸出国というサウジアラビアの役割を考慮すると、サウジの石油インフラへの攻撃は直接的な被害以上の意味を持つと指摘しています。

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: 2019年にアブカイクとクライスで発生した大規模な攻撃など、サウジのエネルギー施設を標的とした過去の事案では、世界の石油供給が一時的に混乱し、国際市場が揺れ動きました。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の見通し

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: 今回の攻撃は、国連の仲介による長年の交渉にもかかわらず、脆い休止状態が定期的に破られている、イエメンの長期化する脆弱な紛争の中で発生しました。

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: 外交官らは、さらなるエスカレーションがリヤドとフーシ派との間のより広範な停戦に向けた最近の努力を脱線させるリスクがあると警告しています。

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: サウジ当局はどのような形で報復が行われるかについての詳細を明らかにしておらず、地域の観測筋は軍事的なエスカレーションの再開の兆候を注視しています。

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: その間、被害を受けた現場では損害査定と修復作業が続けられており、国際エネルギー市場は石油供給への影響について状況を監視しています。

segments.src: *This report reflects information available as of the latest official statements from Saudi authorities and Houthi representatives.
segments.tr: *本リポートは、サウジ当局およびフーシ派代表からの最新の公式声明の時点で利用可能な情報を反映しています。

segments.src: Details may be updated as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: 調査の進展に伴い、詳細は更新される可能性があります。*

segments.tr: ## Eine koordinierte Angriffswelle

segments.tr: Saudi-Arabien wurde am 8. September von einem der umfangreichsten Raketen- und Drohnenangriffe der jüngeren Geschichte getroffen, als die jemenitische Huthi-Bewegung ein koordiniertes Sperrfeuer gegen fünf verschiedene Ziele im gesamten Königreich startete.

segments.src: Authorities say the strikes damaged Abha International Airport, an Aramco fuel distribution terminal, a military air base, and two oil refineries, leaving fires burning at multiple sites and more than 70 people injured.
segments.tr: Behörden zufolge beschädigten die Angriffe den internationalen Flughafen Abha, ein Aramco-Kraftstoffverteilterminal, einen militärischen Luftwaffenstützpunkt und zwei Ölraffinerien, was an mehreren Standorten zu Bränden führte und mehr als 70 Menschen verletzte.

segments.src: Saudi civil defense teams worked through the night to contain blazes at the affected facilities.

segments.src: Officials said the injuries ranged from minor to serious, with most of the wounded reported among airport staff, refinery workers, and nearby residents.

segments.src: No fatalities had been confirmed as of the latest official update.

segments.src: ## What Happened
segments.tr: ## Was ist passiert

segments.src: Interceptors reportedly downed a portion of the incoming projectiles, but several missiles and drones penetrated Saudi airspace and struck their intended targets.
segments.tr: Abfangjäger schossen Berichten zufolge einen Teil der ankommenden Projektile ab, aber mehrere Raketen und Drohnen drangen in den saudischen Luftraum ein und trafen ihre beabsichtigten Ziele.

segments.src: The Aramco fuel terminal sustained a fire that briefly disrupted local distribution operations before crews brought it under control.

segments.src: The two refineries targeted are part of the kingdom's broader energy infrastructure, though officials said production was not significantly interrupted.

segments.src: Abha airport, which serves both civilian and military flights near the Yemeni border, has been targeted in past cross-border attacks and briefly suspended operations following the strike.
segments.tr: Der Flughafen Abha, der sowohl zivile als auch militärische Flüge in der Nähe der jemenitischen Grenze bedient, wurde bereits in früheren grenzüberschreitenden Angriffen ins Visier genommen und stellte nach dem Angriff den Betrieb kurzzeitig ein.

segments.src: ## Houthi Claims and Regional Context
segments.tr: ## Huthi-Ansprüche und regionaler Kontext

segments.tr: Ein militärischer Sprecher der Huthi-Bewegung, die große Teile des nördlichen Jemen kontrolliert, bekannte sich zu der Operation und beschrieb sie als Vergeltung für die anhaltende Rolle der von Saudi-Arabien geführten Koalition im jemenitischen Bürgerkrieg.

segments.src: The group, formally known as Ansar Allah, has for years used long-range missiles and drones to strike Saudi territory, framing the attacks as a response to airstrikes and a blockade it says have devastated Yemen.
segments.tr: Die Gruppe, die offiziell als Ansar Allah bekannt ist, setzt seit Jahren Langstreckenraketen und Drohnen ein, um saudisches Territorium anzugreifen, und rahmt die Angriffe als Reaktion auf Luftangriffe und eine Blockade ein, die ihrer Aussage nach den Jemen verwüstet haben.

segments.src: The Houthis receive political, financial, and reportedly military support from Iran, though Tehran has consistently denied direct involvement in specific attacks.
segments.tr: Die Huthis erhalten politische, finanzielle und Berichten zufolge militärische Unterstützung aus dem Iran, obwohl Teheran eine direkte Beteiligung an spezifischen Angriffen konsequent bestritten hat.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia and its allies have long accused Iran of arming the group with the technology needed to strike targets deep inside the kingdom, an allegation Iranian officials reject as unsubstantiated.
segments.tr: Saudi-Arabien und seine Verbündeten beschuldigen den Iran seit langem, die Gruppe mit der Technologie auszustatten, die für Angriffe tief im Inneren des Königreichs erforderlich ist, ein Vorwurf, den iranische Beamte als unbegründet zurückweisen.

segments.src: ## Saudi Response
segments.tr: ## Saudische Reaktion

segments.src: The kingdom's foreign ministry called on the international community to hold the Houthis and their backers accountable, describing the strikes as a violation of international law and a threat to regional energy security.
segments.tr: Das Außenministerium des Königreichs forderte die internationale Gemeinschaft auf, die Huthis und ihre Unterstützer zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen, und beschrieb die Angriffe als Verletzung des Völkerrechts und Bedrohung der regionalen Energiesicherheit.

segments.src: Analysts note that attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure carry significance beyond the immediate damage, given the kingdom's role as one of the world's largest crude oil exporters.
segments.tr: Analysten merken an, dass Angriffe auf die saudische Ölinfrastruktur angesichts der Rolle des Königreichs als einer der weltweit größten Rohölexporteure eine Bedeutung haben, die über den unmittelbaren Schaden hinausgeht.

segments.src: Previous incidents targeting Saudi energy facilities, including a major 2019 strike on Abqaiq and Khurais, briefly disrupted global oil supply and moved international markets.
segments.tr: Frühere Vorfälle, die auf saudische Energieanlagen abzielten, einschließlich eines großen Angriffs auf Abqaiq und Khurais im Jahr 2019, unterbrachen kurzzeitig die weltweite Ölversorgung und bewegten die internationalen Märkte.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie geht es weiter

segments.src: The attack arrives amid a fragile and long-running conflict in Yemen, where a fragile truce has periodically broken down despite years of United Nations-mediated negotiations.
segments.tr: Der Angriff erfolgt inmitten eines fragilen und langwierigen Konflikts im Jemen, wo ein brüchiger Waffenstillstand trotz jahrelanger, von den Vereinten Nationen vermittelter Verhandlungen periodisch zusammengebrochen ist.

segments.src: Diplomats have warned that further escalation risks derailing recent efforts toward a broader ceasefire between Riyadh and the Houthi movement.
segments.tr: Diplomaten haben gewarnt, dass eine weitere Eskalation das Risiko birgt, die jüngsten Bemühungen um einen umfassenderen Waffenstillstand zwischen Riad und der Huthi-Bewegung zunichtezumachen.

segments.src: Saudi authorities have not detailed what form retaliation might take, and regional observers are watching closely for signs of renewed military escalation.
segments.tr: Die saudischen Behörden haben nicht detailliert dargelegt, welche Form die Vergeltung annehmen könnte, und regionale Beobachter achten genau auf Anzeichen einer erneuten militärischen Eskalation.

segments.src: In the meantime, damage assessments and repair efforts continue at the affected sites, while international energy markets are monitoring the situation for any impact on oil supply.
segments.tr: In der Zwischenzeit gehen die Schadensbewertungen und Reparaturarbeiten an den betroffenen Standorten weiter, während die internationalen Energiemärkte die Situation auf Auswirkungen auf die Ölversorgung beobachten.

segments.tr: *Dieser Bericht spiegelt die Informationen wider, die zum Zeitpunkt der letzten offiziellen Erklärungen der saudischen Behörden und Huthi-Vertreter verfügbar waren.
